aesthetic_description: A dense, high-contrast control panel inspired by developer tools like Portainer and Coolify. The UI prioritizes information density, crisp 1px borders, and a technical feel. It uses a pure dark slate background with stark amber accents reminiscent of classic terminal monitors. Unnecessary padding is reduced in favor of a 'control room' grid layout.

hierarchy.label: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-zinc-500 font-body

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change color slightly on hover. Rows must highlight. Use `transition-colors duration-150`.
motion_and_interaction.modals: Use a heavy backdrop blur (`backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/60`) to focus attention on dialogs.
motion_and_interaction.toast: Slide in from bottom-right. Dark background with subtle colored left-border indicating status (Amber for info, Red for error).

images.description: Dark abstract close-up of illuminated geometric metallic shapes. Apply an overlay like bg-black/70 to ensure login form remains perfectly legible.

icons.usage: Use thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}). Size 16px (w-4 h-4) for standard inline icons, 24px for section headers.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. The Amber accent against Zinc 950 passes this.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: MANDATORY. Every interactive element MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing its role. Examples: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='file-tree-item', data-testid='start-project-btn'.

screen_layouts.login: Split screen or centered card over the geometric background image. Pure utility focus.
screen_layouts.dashboard_shell: Left vertical navigation (64px wide, icons only) + Main content area + Bottom status bar (32px tall).
screen_layouts.projects_dashboard: Grid of project cards (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`). Card displays: Name, Status badge, Uptime, CPU/Mem bars, and quick actions (Play/Stop/Restart).
screen_layouts.project_detail: Bento grid layout. Top row: Status & Actions. Main area: 2-column split. Left: Logs viewer (tall). Right: Environment variables table and Settings switches.
screen_layouts.file_manager: 2-pane layout. Left: Folder tree navigation. Right: Content grid/list with breadcrumb header. Support drag-and-drop file upload overlay.
